Game Day Extras

Empower Field at Mile High

Field pass pickup

  1. Do not enter the stadium. You must pick these up outside, before security.
  2. With all tickets in your mobile wallet, the host will go to this location.
  3. They'll scan each ticket and give you a lanyard.
  4. Meet all guests near entrance 7 at this spot.

Entry and the field

Entering
  1. Once the doors open, you and your guest, with lanyards on, enter and scan your game ticket.
  2. Proceed downstairs to the field level.
On the field
  1. Go left to stay on the Broncos side, or right for the visitor side, which always has a closer view.
  2. You'll have to go around the goal post.
  3. When it's time, field attendants will guide you out.
